chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid Shabab al-Sayrafi, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The virgin daughters of Ismail (peace be upon him) are buried in Al-Hijr, in the section adjacent to the third corner (of the Kaaba).'

key_terms.الْحِجْر: Al-Hijr (the stone enclosure near the Kaaba)

ai.seo_question: Where are the daughters of Ismail buried according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the burial site of the virgin daughters of Prophet Ismail (peace be upon him) within Al-Hijr, adjacent to the third corner of the Kaaba, highlighting the sanctity of this area as a resting place for the Prophet's lineage. This narration underscores the historical continuity of the Kaaba's guardianship and the spiritual significance of Al-Hijr as an extension of the sacred precincts, often associated with the early days of Ibrahim and Ismail's construction of the House. In Shia tradition, this location is revered not only for its physical proximity to the Kaaba but also for its connection to the purity and devotion of the Prophet's descendants.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed Shabaab Al Sayrafi, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Buried in Al-Hijr, from what follows the third corner (of the Kaaba), are the virgin daughters of Ismail<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 16. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about al-Hijr and the House, whether it is the House or there are some parts of the House in it?’

He (the Imam) said, ‘No, not even of the size of a fingernail of the House is in it (al-Hijr). However, Isma’il buried his mother in it and he did not like people’s walking on her grave; so he built a stone wall around it, and graves of prophets are there also.’”
